summary: Validated the new SpendGuard decision replay and Trust Receipt PDF download. The replay progresses through Purchase Request, Authority, Intent, Behavior, Evidence, and final BLOCKED state; reduced-motion mode jumps directly to the final state. The PDF download succeeds and contains the requested product, selected substitute, transaction details, four trust checks, VERIFY decision, reason, and eight-event decision trail. Open Console still reaches its existing in-page destination.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Receipt download is client-side jsPDF and saves spendguard-trust-receipt-000184.pdf. Open Console intentionally preserves the existing in-page destination. Gemini is explicitly out of scope.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issue. An intermediate constants insertion caused a build syntax error and was corrected before final verification. Production build and browser flows passed afterward.
